2026-10-05.title: Where the employer's 12% PF goes
2026-10-05.ig:
Employer ka 12% PF... actually jaata kahan hai? 🤔
Swipe karo 👉 8.33% pension (EPS) mein (₹15,000 wages tak, max ₹1,250), baaki EPF mein. Upar se EDLI aur admin charges alag.

Save karo, accountant ko share karo.

#PF #EPFO #ZeniaHR #Payroll #HRCompliance
2026-10-05.li:
Where does the employer's 12% PF contribution actually go?

• 8.33% goes to the Employees' Pension Scheme (EPS), on wages up to ₹15,000, so a maximum of ₹1,250 a month
• The balance (3.67% plus anything above the EPS cap) goes to EPF, alongside the employee's own 12%
• On top of the 12%, employers pay EDLI (0.5%) and EPF admin charges (0.5%, minimum ₹500)

ZeniaHR calculates every one of these automatically, per employee.

Check current rates on epfindia.gov.in.

#PF #EPFO #Payroll #HRCompliance #ZeniaHR

2026-10-06.title: ESIC: new contribution period
2026-10-06.ig:
ESIC ka naya contribution period shuru: Oct 2026 – Mar 2027 📅
Wage ceiling ₹21,000. Beech mein salary ₹21,000 cross ho gayi? Coverage 31 March tak chalta rahega.

#ESIC #ZeniaHR #Payroll #HRCompliance
2026-10-06.li:
The ESIC contribution period Oct 2026 – Mar 2027 started on 1 October.

• Wage ceiling: ₹21,000 a month (₹25,000 for persons with disability)
• Contribution: employee 0.75%, employer 3.25%
• If an employee's wages cross ₹21,000 during the period, ESIC coverage and deductions continue until the period ends on 31 March

ZeniaHR tracks each employee's contribution period automatically.

2026-10-13.li:
Were minimum wages revised in your state from 1 October?

Many states revise the variable dearness allowance (VDA) twice a year, in April and October. Before October payroll:
1. Download your state's latest notification
2. Map each role to its skill category
3. Update wage rates for every site
4. Re-check PF & ESIC on the new wages

2026-10-15.title: Myth vs fact: PF for contract staff
2026-10-15.ig:
"PF sirf permanent staff ka hota hai"? Bilkul galat! ❌
Contract aur outsourced workers ka bhi PF banta hai. Contractor na bhare toh principal employer liable.

#PF #ContractLabour #ZeniaHR
2026-10-15.li:
Myth: PF is only for permanent staff.
Fact: contract and outsourced workers are covered too, and if the contractor doesn't deposit PF, the principal employer can be held liable.

If you supply manpower, your clients will increasingly ask for proof. ZeniaHR keeps it ready every month.

#PF #ContractLabour #HRCompliance #ZeniaHR
